problem-0.say: A lot of your LLM calls are really decisions.

problem-1.say: Yet you pay a text model to write out every answer.

jev-0.say: TypeSafe Jev answers them directly. Typed answers, and no output tokens.

scan-0.say: Jev-swap finds those calls in your code,

cost-0.say: shows what you'd save. On this Claude Sonnet 5 call, 97.6 percent less, and nearly ten times faster.

convert-0.say: writes the Jev code, with a safe fallback to your LLM,

shadow-0.say: and proves the swap on your real traffic.

outro-0.say: Jev-swap. Try it now, with N P X jev-swap.
